{{Description|She proposed that Remnant creatures are energy bodies derived from "empty shells." They may be able to resonate with humans and be formed in a form beyond the band. By mastering the principle, humans may be able to develop artificial Sonoro Spheres and more Remnant creatures. These hypotheses shocked the academic community, but the Remnant creature that returned from a Sonoro Sphere with her perfectly proved her point.|—Baizhi Backstory, The Endpoint }}
There is not much research or information about Remnant Creatures other than they are made up of purely [[Remnant]] Energy. Many Remnant creatures have gone extinct and what is often left behind are just [[Tacet Discord|imitations]]. 

When a Remnant Creature frequency decays, it can turn into a Tacet Discord.<ref>[[Nimbus Wraith]]</ref>
